convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom with unknown indicator name 'AsimmetricStochNR' and includes external .mqh libraries (SmoothAlgorithms.mqh, TradeAlgorithms.mqh) that contain custom smoothing and trade management logic not available in standard Python libraries.

other_exits: Long position closed when Stoch crosses below Signal line (if BuyPosClose permission enabled)
Short position closed when Stoch crosses above Signal line (if SellPosClose permission enabled)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MM input: negative values = fixed lot size, positive values = share of deposit

custom_logic_notes: Asymmetric Stochastic with Noise Reduction is a custom indicator not available as built-in. The EA uses two buffers from the custom indicator: buffer 0 (main Stoch line) and buffer 1 (signal line). Entry is on crossover/crossunder of these two lines. The crossover detection uses a 2-bar lookback: Stoch[1]>Sign[1] AND Stoch[0]<Sign[0] for buy (crossing up), and inverse for sell. Permission flags (BuyPosOpen, SellPosOpen, BuyPosClose, SellPosClose) gate each action independently. SignalBar=1 means signals are read from the completed bar (bar index 1), not the current forming bar. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose wrapper functions. SmoothAlgorithms.mqh provides CXMA class for smoothing parameter validation.
python_conversion_notes: The custom AsimmetricStochNR indicator must be reimplemented in Python. It appears to be a stochastic oscillator with asymmetric K periods (short=5, long=12), noise reduction, and a smoothed signal line (DMethod=SMA, Dperiod=7, DPhase=15, Slowing=3). The SmoothAlgorithms.mqh suggests the D line may use JJMA/VIDIA/AMA smoothing beyond standard SMA. Trade execution wrappers in TradeAlgorithms.mqh need to be replaced with simple market order logic. Entry logic is straightforward crossover of custom Stoch main vs signal line on completed bars only.
